source.oltp.note: A fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible database service that works with standard PostgreSQL protocols and tools. A columnar engine keeps data in memory in columnar form to speed analytical queries on the same data.

bands.note: Redundant nodes in two zones with automatic failover, read pool instances for read scaling, and continuous backup with point-in-time recovery. Compute and storage scale separately.

presentation.tagline: PostgreSQL-compatible database with a columnar engine for analytics.
